title: The Tithe-Men
text: Men in grey block the road with ledgers under their arms, standing very straight, their faces pale as paper. Everyone pays the tithe, they say, even here. Their ledgers list every House by name, in a hand that never changes.

options.label: The richest House pays them in Essence to buy the road.

outcomes.text: They count it twice, write your House's name in the ledger and step aside.

options.label: Refuse the tithe; no ledger here has any right to you.

outcomes.text: They look at you a long time, then close the ledger and are gone. The ledger remains.
